How a project moves through Commnet

One engineering team owns the job from the first site survey to the long-term SLA.

01

Consultation

Site survey, requirement capture and regulatory mapping (SIRA, ADMCC, ISO 27001).

02

Design

Architecture, BoQ and drawings reviewed with the client and consultant.

03

Engineering

Detailed engineering from the Chennai center: racks, containment, power, network.

04

Implementation

Certified field teams install, terminate and label to industry standard.

05

Testing

Fluke certification, commissioning and authority approvals.

06

Support

AMC and multi-year SLAs, including 8-year managed infrastructure contracts.
